name: Petroglyphic Complexes of the Mongolian Altai
description: In the far west of Mongolia, inside Altai Tavan Bogd National Park, three valleys hold thousands of figures pecked into rock faces and boulders. At Tsagaan Salaa alone, about 10,000 images cover roughly 15 square kilometres, showing hunters, big game and herds of livestock. Together with burial monuments, they trace some 12,000 years of change from hunting to herding to horse-riding nomadism.
